diagram_math_checks.objects: Torus fixed points and arbitrary-field scope.
checks: diag(x,x^-1) acts on [v:w] as [xv:x^-1w]; its two weight lines are [1:0] and [0:1]. The algebraic torus has distinct characters ±chi over every characteristic.
The second fixed point is z=0 in the open cell; the affine cell as a whole is not fixed. The claim concerns the torus algebraic group, not density or distinctness of T(k)-orbits over finite fields.
The image G(k)→PGL2(k) suffices for the action; neither the figure nor Remarks asserts surjectivity on k-points.
